body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: faef96a0dd0d49a1676de9b58d0cc5edccf1536b -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thanks, @vilts - a tidy, well-scoped change.

**What looks good**
- `Machine::rows(unit)` (`crates/post/src/machine/rows.rs`) gives one structured reading shared by the Machine page and the editor header; `summary()` is left alone, so the setup sheet and `boundary_draft` are untouched.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!`/indexing in the new code; unknowns read "not stated", lengths follow the document unit, rotary strokes stay in degrees.
- Layering is respected (ui calls `Machine::rows` through app; no components added). Provenance lines on both new modules; new files are 79 and 22 lines.
- Pinned by `rows_state_each_fact_and_never_a_bare_question_mark` (app) and a structural UI test `the_machine_page_shows_a_property_grid`; no snapshot PNGs touched. Decision file `docs/decisions/745-machine-summary-grid.md` present. Body has `Changelog:`, `Effort:` and `Fixes #745`; no CHANGELOG.md edit; no process-file changes in the net diff, so no PROCESS_VERSION bump is needed.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, trial merge clean; the only incoming file was `.github/FUNDING.yml`)**
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post --lib` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-post --test axis_direction_cli` | 3 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test machine` | 33 passed (incl. the new test) |
| `camcraft-app --test axis_direction --test inverted_axis_display` | 12 + 5 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (cwd `crates/ui`) | 442 passed, 5 ignored (snapshots) |
| ui `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `theme_files` | 3 + 6 + 14 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` is 1871 lines, far past the ~400 law, and this PR adds a few lines net (+12/-8). The new grid code did go into its own `machine_grid.rs`, which is the right direction; carving `machine_section` out of `pages.rs` would be a good follow-up.
- The branch history carries two older "sync process files" commits that net to nothing against main; harmless for a merge-commit merge.
- Narrow-pane wrapping was hand-checked by you per your comment; I did not launch the GUI.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
